name: nullapt/prompt-optimizer
description: Heuristic prompt compression that strips fillers, pleasantries, and verbose phrasings to cut LLM tokens. Deterministic, no network calls, no LLM dependency.
author: nullapt

tools.name: optimize
tools.description: Compress a prompt by removing fillers, polite pleasantries, and verbose phrasings. Returns the rewritten prompt plus token-savings estimates.

keep_polite.description: If true, skip stripping politeness phrases (please, thank you, etc.). Default false.
